title: A monocyte–HDL product is redundant with ratio-aware CRP models: algebra and a cross-sample test
abstract: We tested a log-monocyte by log-HDL product for contemporaneous log-CRP prediction in independently recruited NHANES2007–2008 and2009–2010 adult samples (5213/5615 complete cases). Against flexible demographic, cell-count, lipid and ratio predictors, target weighted MSE gain was -0.00004713 log² units (95% full-pipeline rescaled-PSU bootstrap interval [-0.00131654,0.00105458]). Author algebra and rank checks showed the product adds no source feature-space dimension when component and ratio spline terms already contain their squares. The negative result concerns this parameterization, not the absence of immune–lipid biology or equivalence of all models.
